blueprint.context: The tile was broken at last light and the requirement stands. Vask's six lines to the keeper of the roll at the Level House have been riding on the joint tile since the Dry Ferry and will lift Denet's seal; the Wardenry needs a sealed surveyor to begin the survey and he is the only one inside 385 miles. The Fourth Article's second proviso keeps the seal off paper.
objectives: Stage the humiliation the book has been promising: the Tamm Line goes onto another master's tile as hands
Show why nobody digs -- the destruction of one licence is the whole enforcement
Give Vask the letter and let him hand it back, and let Denet file anyway
Decide the packet: forty leaves north, leaf forty-one south in Ysoly's coat
Send Iseul and Denet north with the seal, the requirement and the halves of a tile

setting.description: The survey camp at the Centre through the twenty-fourth day: the sealed hole and its pin, thirty-six wagons and a hundred and forty draught coming onto the brown ground, a hundred blocks of ballast going back between the axles, and the depot's south bag open on a tailgate at noon.

blueprint.time_of_day: first light to the second hour of the afternoon, day twenty-four

synopsis: First light on the twenty-fourth. The joint tile comes onto the ground -- thirty-six wagons, two hundred people -- and Sild takes the Tamm Line onto his bill as hands before Ysoly can finish asking. Two hundred people look down into fresh water and get back on the boxes, because the enforcement is a woman standing forty feet away with a cut thong. Vask has the Level House letter out of the south bag and gives it back; Denet folds it inside four lines of his own and files both, five months late and one post too early to save him. He cuts the packet open, keeps forty leaves and puts leaf forty-one -- the water-table map -- in Ysoly's hand. He and Iseul ride north.
title: What the Wagon Carries
